body:
spring:
  application:
    name: telemetry-ingestion
  flyway:
    enabled: true
    locations: classpath:db/migration
    url: ${TELEMETRY_JDBC_URL}
  r2dbc:
    url: ${TELEMETRY_R2DBC_URL}
  codec:
    max-in-memory-size: 256KB
  ssl:
    bundle:
      watch:
        file:
          quiet-period: 10s
telemetry:
  reorder-window: 60s
  reorder-buffer-capacity: 1000
  window-duration: 1s
  window-max-events: 500
  bus-capacity: 1024
  broadcast-capacity: 256
  publisher-id: telemetry-ingestion-publisher
  data-key: ${TELEMETRY_DATA_KEY:}
  devices:
    secret-hash: ${TELEMETRY_DEVICE_SECRET_HASH}
  consumers:
    secret-hash: ${TELEMETRY_CONSUMER_SECRET_HASH}
logging:
  file:
    name: logs/telemetry-ingestion.log
  structured:
    format:
      file: ecs
  logback:
    rollingpolicy:
      max-file-size: 10MB
      max-history: 7
  level:
    root: INFO
management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health
server:
  error:
    include-message: never
    include-stacktrace: never
    include-binding-errors: never
  ssl:
    client-auth: want
---
spring:
  config:
    activate:
      on-profile: test
  flyway:
    enabled: true
    url: jdbc:h2:mem:telemetry;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;MODE=PostgreSQL
  r2dbc:
    url: r2dbc:h2:mem:///telemetry;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;MODE=PostgreSQL
